scenario_text: A plant begins using a new solvent in a maintenance area. Employees will decant it into workplace containers and have not previously been trained on its hazards.
organization_context: US workplace covered by federal OSHA; the solvent is hazardous; the employer uses but does not manufacture the chemical.
gold_rationale: Introducing a hazardous chemical requires the chemical list and SDS to be available, workplace containers to be labeled, and employees to be trained on a newly introduced hazard.

gold_rationale: Before operating a newly assigned covered process, the employee needs process and procedure training, and the employer must document receipt and understanding.
